faq.a: Putri is associated with the Sanskrit form بُوتْرِي, whose core sense is putri; daughter (sanskrit).

faq.q: What is the origin of Putri?
faq.a: Putri is associated with Sanskrit. Putri is the Indonesian/Malay form of Sanskrit पुत्री (putrī), meaning 'daughter'. It is used as a female given name.
No — the underlying form is Sanskrit, not Arabic.
Putri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Sanskrit-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Putri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Putrī is a Sanskrit word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Putri mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Putri is rendered پوتري and carries the sense پوتري، بیٹی.

faq.q: What does Putri mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Putri is rendered پوتری and carries the sense پوتری، دختر.
A romanized syllable approximation is put-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Putri?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Putri, putri. Script forms are بُوتْرِي, پوتري, پوتری, पुत्री.

faq.q: Is Putri a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
